source: Nikon press release: Nikon Adds 3D Vision Tracking to Its Robot Vision System (09-30-2026)

players.product: ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems (NSR series), FPD lithography systems and digital lithography systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: Product (robot vision): Nikon is adding a 3D vision tracking feature to its robot vision system (in the market since October 2024) through a paid software update released in October 2026; it uses 3D camera sensors to measure the position, inclination, attitude and orientation of workpieces moving on conveyors without encoders, for picking, insertion and tightening processes such as in automotive production.
